responsibility: Declares the method-resolution layer used for Rust dot-operator lookup. It defines MethodCandidate as a PathProbeCandidate plus the adjustment chain required for the receiver, and declares MethodResolver, an autoderef-driven search utility that probes inherent impls, trait impls, and bound-provided methods for a named path segment.
same_name_distinction: Declares the dot-operator method-resolution abstractions, notably MethodCandidate and MethodResolver, which layer receiver adjustments on top of path-probe candidates. Unlike rust-hir-dot-operator.cc, it defines the API for method lookup rather than performing the autoderef-driven probe itself.
